instruction: Convert the existing Dashboard Journey progress tracker from the right-docked animated side rail into a hidden header dropdown. Remove all docked/collapsed rail behavior and layout reservation. Add a compact Journey stage pill to the workspace top header on Dashboard only for users with paid tracker access. Clicking it opens the unchanged tracker contents as a fixed 322px overlay without pushing page content.
objective: Preserve the Journey Tracker data, stage/task accordion, progress calculation, gating, and My Plan link while changing only its presentation from a docked rail to a default-closed header-triggered overlay.
requiredChanges: remove the 322px and 56px right-docked Journey rail shell, collapsed strip, vertical Journey label, status dots, counter rail, and slide transform behavior
make the tracker occupy zero Dashboard layout space when closed and allow Dashboard content to use the freed width
add a default-closed header pill showing a 15px yellow check circle, Journey label, currentStage/totalStages, and chevron with aria-expanded
render the header pill only when the existing paid Readiness Tracker entitlement is available
open the existing full tracker content as a fixed 322px right-aligned overlay below the 56px header without pushing content
preserve current-stage values, progress percent, eight-stage accordion, task lists, saved timestamp, and Open My Plan behavior
support close from the panel chevron, outside click, and Escape
forbiddenChanges: Journey task or suggestion content changes
